comparison.objective: Ramp a furnace variac safely from 0 V to 60 V; candidate commissions a shock absorber through impact-response trials.
comparison.physical_skill: Both rotate controls, but PR-122 emphasizes knob regrasping and rate control; candidate requires recessed hex-key engagement, setscrew locking, collar counterholding, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: PR-122 limits ramp rate and voltage; candidate requires two safe physical stops, stroke/energy/velocity compliance, and lock retention. PR-122 has no separate spec versions.
comparison.reason: Shared rotary manipulation is generic; the tested physical mechanism and feedback objective differ materially.
